actual_error: FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: .../toolchain/gcc13_jammy/root/usr/bin/g++-13
cause: GCC packages in this repository now split compiler executables into cpp-13-x86-64-linux-gnu, gcc-13-x86-64-linux-gnu and g++-13-x86-64-linux-gnu. The initial list included only the driver/metapackages; its g++ symlink target was absent.
resolution: Download and hash-check the explicit architecture packages from the same Jammy index and extract them inside the project; preserve the earlier package manifest.
